xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4264: GitHub API quota: measure per caller, surface it, back off on limits, and stop wasted polling

plan.title: GitHub API quota: measure per caller, surface it, back off on limits, and stop wasted polling
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator explicitly appended the telemetry scope (operator grouping, quota telemetry, heartbeat, doctor remote view) to this issue on 2026-09-27 and asked for it to be folded into this plan. Every slice reads the same ledger (quota-ledger) and pause gate (pause-gate), so the items share one foundation; they are decomposed as vertical slices with only file-sharing and output-to-input edges so the foreman can fan out. Items 20 and 23-27 may be split into a sibling issue if the surface proves unmanageable.

narratives.Problem: GitHub refuses Overdeck's GraphQL and REST calls several times a day ('API rate limit already exceeded for user ID 678719'), stalling verdicts, close-outs, merges and pipeline membership. Overdeck has no chokepoint or per-caller metering (about 45 files exec gh directly), no shared back-off (only IssueDataService suspends), wastes calls on misconfigured projects and on a repo without the App installed, mints an App token per call, bursts every project at boot and every 5 minutes, and its telemetry cannot group one operator's installs or show GitHub usage.
narratives.Proposal: Add a cross-process JSONL ledger and pause gate under ~/.overdeck/github-quota/, a metered runGh helper plus AsyncLocalStorage caller context, and meter the named callers (pipeline membership, PR cache, PR sync, CI repair, close-out reaper, PAT client, issue poller, App REST door, agents via a count-only gh shim). Sample the free /rate_limit endpoint every 5 minutes. Pause only non-essential callers per pool and bucket, with typed errors that never read as no data. Publish a read-model snapshot to a status-bar pill and a banner whose text says whether this machine caused the limit, and add pan doctor github-quota. Skip projects with no resolvable tracker, fall back to the gh token when the App is not installed, cache App tokens, and stagger boot and convergence refreshes. Add bucketed github_quota_sample, throttled github_rate_limited and daily instance_heartbeat telemetry, the opt-in operatorHash, and a doctor view of sibling installs via PostHog HogQL. Document the policy in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md and docs/TELEMETRY.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Migrating the other ~35 gh exec files (close-issue, workflows, merge-agent, discussions, command-deck, forge, and others) to runGh; their usage shows as unattributed
- Changing src/lib/forge.ts artifact discovery or verdict-recording retries (PAN-4263 owns them)
- Pausing essential callers: merge, verdict recording, tracker writes, agents, pan close / closeOut()
- Blocking or rate-limiting agents' own gh calls; the shim only counts
- Per-repo GitHub App installation discovery or multi-installation support
- Sending any raw count, login, email, hostname, path, repo name or raw user id to PostHog
- A Settings UI for the PostHog read key
- Replacing cache.db rate_limits or IssueDataService's existing back-off
- Webhook-driven quota updates
- Persisting the quota snapshot in overdeck.db or the durable event log

autoDecisions.summary: One plan with sizeJustification instead of sibling issues
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator appended the telemetry scope to this issue and asked for it to be folded into this plan; every slice reads one ledger and pause gate. The foreman may split items 20 and 23-27 into a sibling if needed.

autoDecisions.summary: Cross-process JSONL ledger and pause.json under ~/.overdeck/github-quota/, not cache.db
autoDecisions.rationale: Callers run in the dashboard, deacon child, CLI and agent shells; cache.db lives in server code src/lib must not import, and the /bin/sh agent shim cannot write SQLite.

autoDecisions.summary: Meter only the callers the issue names; the other ~35 gh exec files show as unattributed
autoDecisions.rationale: Migrating 45 files is out of proportion; the free /rate_limit sample exposes the unmetered remainder, and a follow-up can migrate the rest.

autoDecisions.summary: Pause per pool and bucket; essential callers (merge, verdicts, tracker writes, agents, pan close) are never paused
autoDecisions.rationale: The hidden per-user limit hits GraphQL while REST keeps working; blocking essential paths would convert a quota blip into a pipeline stall. PAN-4263 owns verdict retries.

autoDecisions.summary: Record GITHUB_TOKEN usage as a separate 'pat' pool
autoDecisions.rationale: It is unknown whether the PAT belongs to the gh account; separate series cannot contradict each other in the user-pool samples the banner reads.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a count-only gh shim beside the existing agent git guard
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names 'agents via the gh shim' but none exists; the git-guard PATH dir already carries per-agent shims and filters inherited guard dirs.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the closed-union telemetry contract by bucketing points and remaining
autoDecisions.rationale: docs/TELEMETRY.md promises raw counts are never sent and the drift test enforces the domain tables.

autoDecisions.summary: operatorHash = HMAC-SHA256(gh numeric user id, 'overdeck-operator-grouping-v1'), 16 hex, from gh api user via direct execFile
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the operator's spec; the App token has no user; direct execFile avoids an import cycle with runGh. Docs state the salt is a pepper, not a secret.

autoDecisions.summary: PostHog read key and project id live under telemetry: in config.yaml with OVERDECK_POSTHOG_READ_KEY / OVERDECK_POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID overrides; no Settings UI
autoDecisions.rationale: HogQL needs both; keeping the key out of the UI avoids exposing a personal API key.

autoDecisions.summary: pan doctor github-quota is a Commander subcommand of doctor
autoDecisions.rationale: Plain pan doctor keeps its action; a nested command gives its own --json and help.
A running dashboard sends its own heartbeat at most every 24 hours, so a CLI that finds none in 24 hours knows no dashboard did.

autoDecisions.summary: PAN-4263 files (forge.ts, github-pr-lookup.ts, github-pr-selection.ts, forge-transient.ts) are off limits
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4263 is in flight on feature/pan-4263 and owns forge artifact discovery and verdict retry.

Create src/lib/github-quota/ledger.ts (appendLedgerEntry async, readLedgerWindow sync bounded, aggregateLedger (counts every kind 'call' entry at its recorded cost, including agent-shim outcome 'unknown'), pruneLedger, computeOwnUsageLow with OWN_USAGE_LOW_POINTS=500, OWN_USAGE_REMAINING_FRACTION=0.1, SAMPLE_FRESH_MS=600000), caller-context.ts (withGitHubCaller/currentGitHubCaller on AsyncLocalStorage) and classify.ts (classifyGitHubRefusal). Ledger line format is FR-1 exactly; the agent shell shim (agent-gh-shim) writes the same format. Full detail: PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4264.md, Work Item 1.

items.title: Given a tmp OVERDECK_HOME, when appendLedgerEntry writes a call entry, then readLedgerWindow returns that entry and aggregateLedger reports its points under its caller and bucket
Given ledger files older than 3 hours, when pruneLedger runs at an hour rollover, then it deletes them and preserves the current and previous hour files

classifyGitHubRefusal returns { kind: 'primary' } for 'GraphQL: API rate limit already exceeded for user ID 678719', returns { kind: 'secondary', retryAfterSec: 30 } for a secondary-limit message with retry-after: 30, and returns null for a 404
computeOwnUsageLow returns the expected boolean for each of the 4 rows of its truth table (low/high own usage x fresh sample with high/zero remaining)
Add the cross-process GitHub pause gate with refusal listeners

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/github-quota/pause-gate.ts: recordGitHubRefusal applying the FR-5 duration rules (visible primary -> sample resetAt; hidden primary -> 10 min capped at resetAt, floor 60 s; secondary -> retry-after else 60 s doubling to 900 s; x-ratelimit-reset wins only for primary), atomic pause.json write, readActivePause (mtime-cached), assertGitHubCallAllowed(caller, pool, bucket, nowMs) (throws only for a non-essential caller during an active pause on that exact pool and bucket), onGitHubRefusal(listener), GitHubRateLimitedError and GitHubQuotaPausedError. Never import src/lib/telemetry (NFR-8). Full detail: PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4264.md, Work Item 2.

items.title: Given fake timers, when a primary refusal is recorded while the latest sample shows remaining 0, then pause.json holds until equal to that sample's resetAt; with remaining > 0 it holds now + 10 minutes

Given three consecutive secondary refusals without retry-after within 30 minutes, then the pauses last 60, 120 and 240 seconds, and a secondary refusal carrying x-ratelimit-reset one hour out still pauses 60 seconds

During a user GraphQL pause, assertGitHubCallAllowed('pipeline-membership','user','graphql') throws GitHubQuotaPausedError, while ('agent','user','graphql') and ('pipeline-membership','user','rest') return
A listener registered with onGitHubRefusal receives one event per recorded refusal, and a listener that throws does not make recordGitHubRefusal reject
Given an active pat REST pause, when assertGitHubCallAllowed('pipeline-membership','app','rest') and ('pipeline-membership','user','rest') run, then both return rather than throwing

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/github-quota/run-gh.ts: runGh(args, { caller?, cwd?, timeout?, maxBuffer?, exec?, onSuccess? }) resolves the caller, classifies the bucket from args, calls assertGitHubCallAllowed(caller, 'user', bucket), execs gh asynchronously, appends one ledger line (enriched by onSuccess), and on failure records refusals via recordGitHubRefusal and throws GitHubRateLimitedError, otherwise rethrows unchanged. Change src/lib/github-graphql-run.ts defaultExec to runGh with readGraphqlRateLimit as onSuccess. Promise-only, no Effect twin (NFR-5). Full detail: PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4264.md, Work Item 3.
